title: Final Consonants
intro: Explore final consonants and vowel endings. The mark ် closes a consonant syllable; ၺ် appears in vowel combinations ending with an i glide, and ဝ် forms endings with a w glide. Select a letter or sign to see its explanation and syllable examples.

items.label: -m
items.note: Final m /m/

detail.title: Final -m
detail.intro: မ် is မ with the final mark ်. It closes a syllable with /m/, made with the lips together. Compare the endings below as the vowel changes.

detail.title: Final -ng
detail.intro: င် is င with the final mark ်. It closes a syllable with /ŋ/, like the final sound of English sing. The ng label represents one sound; do not add a separate g sound.
